metadata.description: Single-plugin marketplace that distributes the Telarchy skills. Five skills for the Telarchy API: evaluate an idea as a priced proposal, run a workspace as its owner, design metrics by Telarchy's doctrine, and trade as a participant (limit orders, liquidity, seasons, telemetry), plus an index.
